## Define data loading and cleaning function
```{r define age weighted brood year function}
#Upper Columbia fish outmigrate at a mix of ages, so a flat
#outmigrationyear - 2 offset isn't appropriate. Weights juveniles by
#age-class proportion, calculates brood year per age class, then sums
#across ages. Returns an empty result if required columns are missing
#or no rows survive filtering (ex. a population with all-NA age data)
age_weighted_broodyear_function <- function(data){
  required_cols <- c("outmigrationyear", "totalnatural", "agency", "protmethname", "methodadjustments",
                      "age0prop", "age1prop", "age2prop", "age3prop", "age4plusprop", "populationname")
  
  missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, colnames(data))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    cat(glue::glue("age_weighted_broodyear_function: missing expected columns: {paste(missing_cols, collapse = ', ')} - returning empty result\n"))
    return(data.frame(populationname = character(), broodyear = numeric(), totalnatural = numeric(),
                       juvout_agency = character(), juvout_protmethname = character(), juvout_methodadjustments = character()))
  }
  
  data_long <- bind_rows(
    data %>% mutate(age = 0, age_prop = age0prop),
    data %>% mutate(age = 1, age_prop = age1prop),
    data %>% mutate(age = 2, age_prop = age2prop),
    data %>% mutate(age = 3, age_prop = age3prop),
    data %>% mutate(age = 4, age_prop = age4plusprop)
  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(outmigrationyear), !is.na(age_prop)) %>%
    mutate(
      age_juveniles = totalnatural * age_prop,
      broodyear = outmigrationyear - age
    )
  
  if (nrow(data_long) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(populationname = character(), broodyear = numeric(), totalnatural = numeric(),
                       juvout_agency = character(), juvout_protmethname = character(), juvout_methodadjustments = character()))
  }
  
  data_long %>%
    group_by(populationname, broodyear) %>%
    summarize(
      totalnatural = sum(age_juveniles, na.rm = TRUE),
      juvout_agency = first(agency),
      juvout_protmethname = first(protmethname),
      juvout_methodadjustments = first(methodadjustments)
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
}

#Snake River Chinook uses a confirmed migr_year - 2 offset. Steelhead
#uses the same -2 offset, treating age 2 as yearling
snake_broodyear_function <- function(data, species_sel){
  data %>%
    mutate(
      brood_year_equiv = case_when(
        species_sel == "Chinook" ~ outmigrationyear - 2,
        species_sel == "Steelhead" ~ outmigrationyear - 2,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      )
    ) %>%
    select(populationname, outmigrationyear, brood_year_equiv, totalnatural,
           juvout_agency = agency, juvout_protmethname = protmethname,
           juvout_methodadjustments = methodadjustments)
}
```

```{r define presentation theme and export function}
presentation_theme <- theme(
  text = element_text(family = "Times New Roman", face = "bold", size = 22),
  plot.title = element_text(size = 28, face = "bold"),
  axis.title = element_text(size = 22),
  axis.text = element_text(size = 18),
  strip.text = element_text(size = 18),
  legend.text = element_text(size = 18),
  legend.title = element_text(size = 20)
)

ggsave_presentation <- function(filename, height = 7.5, width = 13.33, dpi = 300){
  ggsave(here("Results", "Figures", filename), height = height, width = width, dpi = dpi)
}

wrap_title <- function(text, width = 28){
  paste(strwrap(text, width = width), collapse = "\n")
}

#Splits populationname into location_name and run_species. Most names
#use " - " as a separator; some have no dash and instead end in a
#run/species phrase, which is matched and stripped separately
split_pop_name <- function(df){
  split_cols <- stringr::str_split_fixed(df$populationname, " - ", n = 2)
  
  location_name <- split_cols[, 1]
  run_species <- split_cols[, 2]
  
  run_species_patterns <- c(
    "spring Chinook Salmon", "summer Chinook Salmon", "fall Chinook Salmon",
    "spring/summer Chinook Salmon", "summer Steelhead", "spring Steelhead"
  )
  
  no_dash <- run_species == ""
  
  for (pattern in run_species_patterns) {
    matches <- no_dash & endsWith(location_name, paste0(" ", pattern))
    run_species[matches] <- pattern
    location_name[matches] <- trimws(sub(paste0(" ", pattern, "$"), "", location_name[matches]))
  }
  
  df %>%
    mutate(
      location_name = location_name,
      run_species = run_species
    )
}

#Juvenile outmigrants per spawner, faceted by population. Populations
#with no calculable ratio get a "No age data available" label centered
#on an invisible 0-1 scale, so the panel renders with a visible label
#instead of blank space
plot_juvout_per_spawner_function <- function(data, basin_sel, species_sel, plot_title, file_name){
  subset_data <- data %>%
    filter(basin == basin_sel, species == species_sel) %>%
    split_pop_name()
  
  no_data_pops <- subset_data %>%
    group_by(location_name) %>%
    summarize(has_ratio = any(!is.na(juvout_per_spawner))) %>%
    filter(has_ratio == FALSE) %>%
    pull(location_name)
  
  no_data_labels <- subset_data %>%
    filter(location_name %in% no_data_pops) %>%
    group_by(location_name) %>%
    summarize(broodyear = mean(broodyear, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    mutate(label_text = "No age data available")
  
  subset_data %>%
    filter(!is.na(juvout_per_spawner)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = broodyear, y = juvout_per_spawner, color = location_name)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    geom_blank(data = no_data_labels, aes(x = broodyear, y = 0), inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_blank(data = no_data_labels, aes(x = broodyear, y = 1), inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_text(data = no_data_labels, aes(x = broodyear, y = 0.5, label = label_text),
              color = "red", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    facet_wrap(~ location_name, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(title = plot_title,
         x = "Brood Year", y = "JuvOut / Spawner") +
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
    presentation_theme +
    theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 13))
  
  ggsave_presentation(file_name)
}

#Single-color version, no color-by-population legend
plot_juvout_per_spawner_single_color_function <- function(data, basin_sel, species_sel, plot_title, file_name){
  data %>%
    filter(!is.na(juvout_per_spawner), basin == basin_sel, species == species_sel) %>%
    split_pop_name() %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = broodyear, y = juvout_per_spawner)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1, color = "blue") +
    geom_point(size = 2, color = "blue") +
    facet_wrap(~ location_name) +
    labs(title = plot_title,
         x = "Brood Year", y = "JuvOut / Spawner") +
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
    presentation_theme +
    theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 13))
  
  ggsave_presentation(file_name)
}
```

```{r build population huc8 and subbasin lookups}
huc_population_all %>%
  count(nwfsc_pop_id) %>%
  filter(n > 1)

#Collapses all huc_8 codes for a population into one text field, so
#joining doesn't duplicate rows for populations spanning multiple huc_8s
population_huc8_lookup <- huc_population_all %>%
  mutate(nwfsc_pop_id = as.character(nwfsc_pop_id)) %>%
  select(nwfsc_pop_id, population, hydrologic_huc_8) %>%
  unique() %>%
  group_by(nwfsc_pop_id, population) %>%
  summarize(huc8_list = paste(hydrologic_huc_8, collapse = ", "))

columbia_huc8 <- read.csv(here("Datasets", "columbia_huc8.csv")) %>%
  clean_names()

#Same collapsing pattern as above, but for subbasin names
population_subbasin_lookup <- huc_population_all %>%
  mutate(nwfsc_pop_id = as.character(nwfsc_pop_id),
         hydrologic_huc_8 = as.character(hydrologic_huc_8)) %>%
  select(nwfsc_pop_id, hydrologic_huc_8) %>%
  left_join(columbia_huc8 %>% mutate(huc8 = as.character(huc8)),
            by = c("hydrologic_huc_8" = "huc8")) %>%
  select(nwfsc_pop_id, subbasin_name) %>%
  unique() %>%
  group_by(nwfsc_pop_id) %>%
  summarize(subbasin_name_list = paste(subbasin_name, collapse = ", "))
```

```{r build uncollapsed population huc8 lookup}
#Uncollapsed version of the lookup above, one row per population/huc_8
#pair - used for joining JuvOut onto huc_8 directly
population_huc8_unpacked <- huc_population_all %>%
  mutate(nwfsc_pop_id = as.character(nwfsc_pop_id)) %>%
  select(nwfsc_pop_id, population, hydrologic_huc_8) %>%
  unique()

nrow(population_huc8_unpacked)

population_huc8_unpacked %>%
  count(nwfsc_pop_id, population) %>%
  filter(n > 1)
```

```{r check age proportions sum to one}
#Verifies age0prop through age4plusprop sum to ~1, so totalnatural is
#fully distributed across age classes. Run for all four core subsets
check_age_prop_sum_function <- function(data, title_label){
  prop_check <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(age0prop) | !is.na(age1prop) | !is.na(age2prop) | !is.na(age3prop) | !is.na(age4plusprop)) %>%
    mutate(
      age_prop_total = rowSums(across(c(age0prop, age1prop, age2prop, age3prop, age4plusprop)), na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  
  cat(glue::glue("{title_label}: age proportion sums (should be close to 1)\n"))
  print(summary(prop_check$age_prop_total))
  
  off_rows <- prop_check %>%
    filter(age_prop_total < 0.95 | age_prop_total > 1.05)
  
  cat(glue::glue("{title_label}: {nrow(off_rows)} rows with age proportions summing outside 0.95-1.05\n"))
  
  return(off_rows)
}

upcol_chinook_age_prop_issues <- check_age_prop_sum_function(juvout_clean, "Upper Columbia Chinook")
upcol_steelhead_age_prop_issues <- check_age_prop_sum_function(juvout_upper_col_steelhead, "Upper Columbia Steelhead")
snake_chinook_age_prop_issues <- check_age_prop_sum_function(juvout_snake_chinook, "Snake River Chinook")
snake_steelhead_age_prop_issues <- check_age_prop_sum_function(juvout_snake_steelhead, "Snake River Steelhead")

datatable(upcol_chinook_age_prop_issues)
datatable(upcol_steelhead_age_prop_issues)
datatable(snake_chinook_age_prop_issues)
datatable(snake_steelhead_age_prop_issues)
```

```{r aggregate rpers nosa juvout upper columbia chinook}
#Filters both NOSA and RperS to bestvalue == "Yes" before joining, so
#duplicate-agency rows are resolved before the three-way join
nosa_for_aggregation <- nosa_upper_columbia %>%
  filter(bestvalue == "Yes") %>%
  select(populationname, spawningyear, tsaij, tsaej, nosaij, nosaej,
         nosa_agency = agency, nosa_protmethname = protmethname,
         nosa_methodadjustments = methodadjustments)

juvout_for_aggregation <- age_weighted_broodyear_function(juvout_clean)

#Joins RperS (base) to NOSA by population/year, then to age-weighted
#JuvOut by population/broodyear
rpers_nosa_juvout_aggregate <- upper_col_sp_chin_rpers %>%
  filter(bestvalue == "Yes") %>%
  select(populationname, nmfs_popid, broodyear, rpers, totalspawners, hatcheryspawners,
         rpers_agency = agency, rpers_protmethname = protmethname,
         rpers_methodadjustments = methodadjustments) %>%
  left_join(nosa_for_aggregation, by = c("populationname" = "populationname", "broodyear" = "spawningyear")) %>%
  left_join(juvout_for_aggregation, by = c("populationname" = "populationname", "broodyear" = "broodyear"))

sum(!is.na(rpers_nosa_juvout_aggregate$tsaij) & !is.na(rpers_nosa_juvout_aggregate$totalnatural))
nrow(rpers_nosa_juvout_aggregate)

write.csv(rpers_nosa_juvout_aggregate,
          here("Results", "CSV Files", "rpers_nosa_juvout_aggregate_upper_columbia.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

rpers_nosa_juvout_aggregate_pop <- rpers_nosa_juvout_aggregate %>%
  mutate(nmfs_popid = as.character(nmfs_popid)) %>%
  left_join(population_huc8_lookup, by = c("nmfs_popid" = "nwfsc_pop_id"))

nrow(rpers_nosa_juvout_aggregate)
nrow(rpers_nosa_juvout_aggregate_pop)
```

```{r calculate juvout per spawner}
#Direct JuvOut/spawner ratio: natural-origin juveniles (totalnatural)
#divided by total spawners (totalspawners) for the same population and
#brood year. This is the simple version, not the SAR-based Freshwater
#Productivity Index approach
all_basins_combined <- all_basins_combined %>%
  mutate(
    juvout_per_spawner = case_when(
      !is.na(totalnatural) & !is.na(totalspawners) & totalspawners > 0 ~ totalnatural / totalspawners,
      TRUE ~ NA
    )
  )

sum(!is.na(all_basins_combined$juvout_per_spawner))
nrow(all_basins_combined)

all_basins_combined %>%
  filter(!is.na(juvout_per_spawner)) %>%
  group_by(basin, species) %>%
  summarize(
    min_ratio = min(juvout_per_spawner),
    median_ratio = median(juvout_per_spawner),
    mean_ratio = mean(juvout_per_spawner),
    max_ratio = max(juvout_per_spawner)
  )

write.csv(all_basins_combined,
          here("Results", "CSV Files", "rpers_nosa_juvout_combined_all_basins.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r join hatchery releases to combined dataset}
#Joins summed hatchery release numbers, keyed on mgr_year against
#all_basins_combined's broodyear
all_basins_combined <- all_basins_combined %>%
  left_join(hatchery_release_by_population_year,
            by = c("population" = "population", "species" = "species_full", "broodyear" = "mgr_year"))

sum(!is.na(all_basins_combined$total_hatchery_released))
nrow(all_basins_combined)

write.csv(all_basins_combined,
          here("Results", "CSV Files", "rpers_nosa_juvout_combined_all_basins.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r plot juvout by huc8, fig.height = 7.5, fig.width = 13.33}
#Faceted by huc_8 instead of population, to assess whether aggregating
#JuvOut up to huc_8 level looks feasible
juvout_all_combined %>%
  split_pop_name() %>%
  filter(!is.na(hydrologic_huc_8), !is.na(outmigrationyear)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = outmigrationyear, y = totalnatural, color = location_name)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ hydrologic_huc_8, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(title = "JuvOut Natural Origin Outmigrants\nby HUC8 and Year",
       x = "Year", y = "Total Natural Outmigrants", color = "Population") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  presentation_theme

ggsave_presentation("juvout_by_huc8_year.png")
```

```{r density dependence check, fig.height = 7.5, fig.width = 13.33}
#Checks for density-dependent effects: does juvout/spawner decline as
#spawner density increases?
all_basins_combined %>%
  split_pop_name() %>%
  filter(!is.na(juvout_per_spawner), !is.na(totalspawners)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = totalspawners, y = juvout_per_spawner, color = species)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ location_name, scales = "free") +
  labs(title = "Juvenile Outmigrants per Spawner vs. Spawner Abundance\n(Density-Dependence Check)",
       x = "Total Spawners", y = "JuvOut / Spawner", color = "Species") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  presentation_theme +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 13))

ggsave_presentation("juvout_per_spawner_vs_spawners_density_check.png")
```

```{r hatchery release effect check, fig.height = 7.5, fig.width = 13.33}

  ggplot(aes(x = total_hatchery_released, y = juvout_per_spawner, color = species)) +
```
